text: Implemented typed SurfaceSeconds/SurfaceTimeAxis interpolation, lazy SurfaceMatrix and SurfaceDoubleFrameSource fields, immutable bounded LRU caching with prefetch/source-read/eviction receipts, pure playback reducer, topology-safe morphing with explicit normal policy, world-coordinate image links, ordinary packed-RGBA annotation overlays, and bounded deterministic selection history. Shared surface-view suites pass 30/30 on JVM and 30/30 on Scala.js. Current live JavaFX 32k/164k matrix passes; at 164k and 8 layers camera-only was 0.148 ms with zero uploads and timepoint update was 35.039 ms with zero geometry uploads. Fresh Chrome/WebGL2 matrix earlier this turn passed all 48 cases, including target-size timepoint updates and picks.
